Two-step trace, determinant and strict Jury inequalities reduce attraction to P(t)<0 and |K/t-a-11t/20|>4sqrt3/11. Descartes plus rational root brackets certify precisely two disjoint parameter bands, with -1 and unit-complex boundaries. No higher-period or critical-boundary nonlinear claims.
